WHAT WE DO WEDNESDAY 🗳️
Before the first ballot is cast in any election, voting machines undergo a detailed setup process to ensure they’re ready to record your vote.
With Early Voting underway and Election Day less than two weeks away, we’re taking you behind the scenes at Horry County’s Voter Registration and Elections Office for a closer look at the preparation that goes into every election.
As our elections team works to get everything ready, here are a few important reminders for voters:
🇺🇸Early Voting: Open through Saturday, Oct. 31, and closed Sunday. Early Voting centers are open from 8:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. Monday through Saturday at designated early voting centers. 
🇺🇸Election Day: Tuesday, Nov. 3.
Have questions about the election process? Visit scVOTES.gov for helpful voter information and resources. | Horry County Government
